verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the public Expensify/App GitHub repo, whose README shows the app can be installed (`npm install`) and run locally (`npm run web`). That suggests the client source is open and runnable, but nothing shows the core backend or service can be self-hosted independently of Expensify's cloud. Missing for 10: evidence that the backend/server can be self-hosted, self-hosting deployment docs, and hands-on confirmation that a fully self-hosted instance works.
